summary.text: Burgess Owens represents Utah's 4th District and is Vice Chair of the House Education and Workforce Committee.

paragraphs.text: He earned a B.S. in biology and chemistry at the University of Miami and played ten seasons as a safety in the NFL with the New York Jets and Oakland Raiders.
Before being elected to Congress he worked in corporate sales and founded Second Chance 4 Youth, a nonprofit for troubled and incarcerated youth.
